reason: The template uses triple-stash for stopNotificiationsText (templates/topic/unsubscribe.hbs:139), which fills in model.fancyTitle (controllers/topic-unsubscribe.js.es6:29). That value is already HTML-escaped on the server, because Topic#fancy_title calls ERB::Util.html_escape(title) (app/models/topic.rb:264), so user-controlled markup cannot get through.
